description: This PHP script handles user authentication, including login, session management, LDAP integration, OAuth, and Single Sign-On (SSO) support for the TestLink open source project. It defines functions for user authorization, session setup, external authentication methods, and LDAP user information retrieval.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Represents a user in the system, with methods for database operations and credential verification.

methods.name: doAuthorize
methods.description: Handles user login authentication, session management, and user creation if necessary, supporting OAuth and LDAP authentication mechanisms.

methods.name: doSSOClientCertificate
methods.description: Performs user authentication via SSL client certificates, managing user sessions accordingly.

methods.name: auth_does_password_match
methods.description: Verifies if the provided password matches the stored password for a user, supporting LDAP, MD5, and database authentication methods.

methods.name: getUserFieldsFromLDAP
methods.description: Retrieves user details from LDAP server based on login and LDAP configuration.

methods.name: doSSOWebServerVar
methods.description: Processes web server environment variables for SSO authentication, setting user sessions if a matching user is found.

methods.name: doSessionSetUp
methods.description: Establishes user session information and security cookies after successful authentication.
